metadata.title: PertPy Perturb-seq Demo: A Reproducible Python Pipeline for CRISPR Single-Cell Perturbation Analysis
metadata.description:
A reproducible Python-based perturbation analysis pipeline using PertPy and Scanpy for CRISPR Perturb-seq datasets.

This software demonstrates a full VS Code-friendly workflow for:
- Dataset download
- Metadata inspection
- Perturbation label preparation
- Pseudobulk perturbation profile construction
- Control-difference computation
- PCA/UMAP perturbation-space visualization
- Top-gene reporting

The pipeline uses the Norman & Weissman 2019 Perturb-seq benchmark dataset from the scPerturb collection and is designed for computational biology education, portfolio development, and reproducible research.

GitHub repository:
https://github.com/TaufiaHussain/pertpy-perturbation-analysis

hits.title: PertPy Perturb-seq Demo: A Reproducible Python Pipeline for CRISPR Single-Cell Perturbation Analysis

metadata.title: CRC_MetaThermo_v1: Reproducible processed data package for integrated single-cell analysis of colorectal cancer metastasis
metadata.description:
This repository contains the minimal processed data package supporting the study:

“Integrated single-cell analysis of colorectal cancer metastasis reveals a stress-associated trajectory and constrained pharmacological reversal landscape.”

The package includes:

• Integrated scVI harmonized single-cell atlas (AnnData format)
• Metadata annotations
• Differential expression outputs
• Metastasis-associated transcriptional signatures
• Immune and tumor trajectory statistics
• Drug perturbation overlap results
• Network and mechanism-flow analysis tables
• Figure source tables supporting principal manuscript figures

Original datasets analyzed in this study are publicly available from GEO under accession numbers:

GSE178318
GSE231559
GSE298084
GSE299737
GSE110009

This release represents a minimal reproducible scientific package intended to support manuscript reproducibility. Internal automation systems, server infrastructure, API orchestration, and commercial platform components are intentionally excluded.

creators.name: Alizargar, Javad
creators.affiliation: National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Science
